Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of HD.
Operating income reached $7.5 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Revenue guidance of $11.7 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2022.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1364 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 180 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $11.7 billion this quarter, representing 16% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 16% to 20% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
